name: panesPosition
label: Panes position
description: Defines the layout of the panes.

name: defaultDisplayedPane
label: Default displayed pane
description: Defines which pane to display when the page loads for the first time.

name: singleColumn
label: Stack resizable panes
description:
Allows horizontal resizable panes to stack vertically, orienting the right pane under the left pane. 
 When responsive authoring is not enabled, this property is controlled by auto reflow rules.

name: disabled
label: Fixed
description: Prevents the user from resizing panes using the divider.

name: actionBar
label: Display action bar
description: Allows the user to switch between different view modes.

name: actionBarConfig
label: Action bar configuration
defaultValue: {"leftIcon":"record-activity-details-fill", "middleIcon":"record-activity-stream-outline", "rightIcon":"record-activity-outline", "leftTooltip":"Show left pane", "middleTooltip":"Show both panes", "rightTooltip":"Show right pane"}
description: Defines icons and tooltips used by the action bar to switch between different view modes. Enter a JSON string in the format {leftIcon:string, middleIcon:string, rightIcon:string, leftTooltip:string, middleTooltip:string, rightTooltip:string}.

name: displayDividerButton
label: Display divider button
description: Show an iconic button on the divider bar.

name: dividerButtonConfig
label: Divider button configuration
description: Defines properties for iconic button on the divider bar.

name: defaultDividerPosition
label: Default divider position
description: Number between 0 and 100 that sets where to place the divider by default. To place the divider all the way to the left, enter 0. To place the divider all the way to the right, enter 100. To place the divider exactly in the middle of the panes, enter 50.

name: leftPaneConstraints
label: Minimum width of left pane
description: Sets the minimum width of the left pane. You can set this size as a ratio between 0 and 100 and/or as a number of pixels. Use the JSON string format {minRatio:number, minPixels:number}.

name: rightPaneConstraints
label: Minimum width of right pane
description: Sets the minimum width of the right pane. You can set this size as a ratio between 0 and 100 and/or as a number of pixels. Enter a JSON string in the format {minRatio:number, minPixels:number}.

name: topPaneConstraints
label: Minimum height of top pane
description: Sets the minimum height of the top pane. You can set this size as a ratio between 0 and 100 and/or as a number of pixels. Use the JSON string format {minRatio:number, minPixels:number}.

name: bottomPaneConstraints
label: Minimum height of bottom pane
description: Sets the minimum height of the bottom pane. You can set this size as a ratio between 0 and 100 and/or as a number of pixels. Enter a JSON string in the format {minRatio:number, minPixels:number}.

name: dividerStyles
label: Divider styles
description: Custom CSS styles for the divider, expressed in JSON format. For example, to add padding and make the background color red, you would enter {"padding":"10px","background-color":"red"}.

name: bare
label: Bare
description: Add or remove borders around the panes.
